skill.name: clinpgx-database
skill.description: Access ClinPGx pharmacogenomics data for gene-drug interactions, CPIC guidelines, allele functions, drug labels, and precision medicine research workflows.
skill.summary: Query ClinPGx pharmacogenomics resources for gene-drug evidence and guideline review.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The skill is a legitimate ClinPGx API helper, but it includes extensive outbound network examples and scripts that can transmit medication and genotype terms. Filesystem writes are limited to explicit cache and export helpers, while external-command and system-reconnaissance detections were Markdown or terminology false positives. No prompt injection text was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Add explicit guidance to de-identify genotype, medication, and patient context before ClinPGx API calls.
Constrain cache and export paths to a safe workspace directory and warn before overwriting files.
Document retention limits and deletion steps for cached pharmacogenomics query results.
State that outputs are evidence summaries and not standalone prescribing instructions.

content.value_statement: Pharmacogenomics data is fragmented across guidelines, labels, variants, and drug annotations. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code query ClinPGx resources and summarize evidence clearly.
actual_capabilities: Looks up ClinPGx gene, drug, allele, variant, guideline, label, and pathway resources.
Shows Python request patterns for ClinPGx REST API endpoints.
Provides a helper script with rate limiting, retry handling, caching, and dataframe export.
Supports gene-drug pair review using CPIC, DPWG, FDA, and literature sources.
Explains pharmacogenomics workflows for medication review, panel analysis, and evidence review.
limitations: It depends on ClinPGx API availability and current endpoint behavior.
It does not replace licensed clinical judgment or local prescribing policy.
API queries and cache files may contain sensitive genotype or medication data.
Results can change as ClinPGx, CPIC, and PharmVar update their data.

use_cases.title: Review a Gene-Drug Pair
use_cases.description: Check a gene and medication against ClinPGx evidence, guidelines, labels, and clinical annotations.

use_cases.title: Analyze a Pharmacogenomics Panel
use_cases.description: Compare multiple pharmacogenes with available drug interactions and evidence levels for cohort planning.

use_cases.title: Prototype a ClinPGx Integration
use_cases.description: Use the helper script and API reference to design rate-limited queries and local result caching.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Gene-Drug Pair
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner lookup for one pharmacogenomic relationship.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ClinPGx to look up CYP2C19 and clopidogrel. Summarize the CPIC level, guideline source, and main caution.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Medication List
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review across several medications and genes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare clopidogrel, simvastatin, and codeine with CYP2C19, SLCO1B1, and CYP2D6. Flag high-evidence interactions and cite source types.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Panel Query
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced query planning for a pharmacogene panel.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a ClinPGx query plan for CYP2D6, CYP2C19, CYP2C9, TPMT, DPYD, and SLCO1B1. Include rate limits and caching steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Evidence Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced synthesis across multiple ClinPGx resources.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ClinPGx endpoints to compare CPIC guidelines, clinical annotations, drug labels, and allele functions for TPMT and azathioprine.

output_examples.output: A concise summary of the gene-drug pair, CPIC source status, evidence level, and caution to verify current guidelines.

output: An interaction table organized by gene and medication.
Evidence notes that separate guideline sources from literature annotations.
A reminder to avoid clinical action without local review.

output_examples.output: A query plan with endpoints, filters, rate limits, cache choices, and checks for updated ClinPGx data.

best_practices: De-identify patient data before API queries and cache storage.
Check evidence level, guideline date, and source before clinical use.
Respect rate limits and store only the results needed for the task.
anti_patterns: Do not send identifiable health data to external APIs without approval.
Do not treat low-evidence annotations as dosing orders.
Do not run bulk queries without ClinPGx rate limit controls.

faq.question: Does this skill require authentication?
faq.answer: The referenced ClinPGx examples state that basic API access does not require authentication.

faq.question: Can it make clinical prescribing decisions?
faq.answer: No. It can gather and summarize evidence, but qualified clinicians must make prescribing decisions.

faq.question: What data sources does it emphasize?
faq.answer: It emphasizes ClinPGx, CPIC, PharmCAT, DPWG, FDA labels, allele data, and clinical annotations.

faq.question: Can it help developers use the API?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes endpoint examples, rate limiting guidance, caching patterns, and a Python helper script.

faq.question: How should sensitive data be handled?
faq.answer: Use de-identified inputs, avoid patient identifiers, and review institutional rules before external API calls.

faq.question: Does the skill work offline?
faq.answer: Documentation can be read offline, but live ClinPGx lookups require network access to the API.
